 Illustration/Aktualita.co - The Dewa United vs Persija Jakarta duel in the 2026/2027 BRI Super League is scheduled to take place at Banten International Stadium, Saturday (10/31/2026), at 19:00 WIB. Both teams are competing for crucial points at the top of the standings. 
 SERANG, Aktualita.co -  The Dewa United vs Persija Jakarta match will be one of the most anticipated games in the eighth week of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League. Both teams are scheduled to meet at Banten International Stadium, Serang, on Saturday (10/31/2026), with kick-off at 19:00 WIB. 
 This match is not just about fighting for three points. Persija arrives as the current league leader with 18 points from seven matches, while Dewa United follows in second place with 14 points. 
 Advertisement 
 A victory would allow Persija to extend their lead to seven points. Conversely, if Dewa United can defeat the Macan Kemayoran, the gap between the two teams will shrink to just one point. 
 This situation makes the duel in Serang potentially one of the most decisive matches in the top-tier competition at the start of the season. 
 Persija has better momentum after securing two consecutive wins. Dewa United, on the other hand, is trying to bounce back from a crushing defeat that ended their unbeaten record. 
 Persija Jakarta Arrives with Two Consecutive Wins 
 Persija Jakarta is showing positive performance under the guidance of coach Shin Tae-yong. 
 The Macan Kemayoran managed to defeat Arema FC with a score of 5-1 on October 21, 2026, and then continued their winning streak by beating Persik Kediri 2-1 on Monday (10/26/2026). 
 The victory over Persik was not easy. Persija trailed early after Imanol Garcia gave the visitors the lead in the 10th minute. 
 However, the situation changed in the second half. Denis Kolinger scored the equalizer in the 64th minute, before Rizky Ridho secured the win with a goal five minutes later. 
 The result also demonstrated Persija's ability to bounce back when under pressure. 
 Persija coach, Shin Tae-yong, appreciated his players' hard work after the match against Persik. 
 "Our players fought until the end without giving up and showed a maximum performance. I think that is the biggest factor that led us to victory," said Shin Tae-yong. Nevertheless, facing Dewa United at their home ground is expected to be a different challenge. Persija needs to maintain concentration, especially when dealing with the host's quick attacks and pressure from the midfield. 
 Dewa United Wants to Bounce Back After Being Hammered 0-4 by Arema FC 
 Unlike Persija, Dewa United comes in with a major homework assignment after losing 0-4 to Arema FC at Kanjuruhan Stadium, Sunday (10/25/2026). 
 That result was the Banten Warriors' first defeat this season and ended a six-match unbeaten streak. 
 Previously, Dewa United had performed consistently with four wins and two draws. 
 They even briefly took the top spot in the standings after defeating Persijap Jepara 2-0 on October 20. 
 However, the match against Arema revealed several weaknesses, especially when the defensive line faced the opponent's attacks. 
 Dewa United coach, Osmar Loss, did not make excuses after his team suffered the defeat. 
 "Congratulations to Arema for this victory. Regarding the 4-0 score, there is not much to say because the match result explains everything," said Osmar Loss. 
 Facing Persija, Dewa United is required to show a better response. 
 The presence of players like Egy Maulana Vikri, Alexis Messidoro, and Taisei Marukawa could be an important factor in the host's efforts to build attacks. 
 Dewa United also has the advantage of playing in front of their own supporters. However, home advantage will not help much if they lose their defensive organization again as they did in the previous match. 
 Head to Head Dewa United vs Persija Jakarta 
 Meetings between the two teams in recent seasons have often resulted in tight matches. 
 Based on competition operator data, from the previous eight meetings, Persija recorded four wins, Dewa United two wins, and two matches ended in a draw. 
 Here are some of the last meetings between the two teams: 
 Date Match Score 
 March 15, 2026 Persija vs Dewa United 1-1 
 August 29, 2025 Dewa United vs Persija 1-3 
 February 8, 2025 Dewa United vs Persija 2-1 
 September 16, 2024 Persija vs Dewa United 0-0 
 The last meeting on March 15, 2026, ended in a 1-1 draw at the Jakarta International Stadium. 
 At that time, Persija took the lead through Maxwell Souza before Alexis Messidoro equalized for Dewa United. 
 Meanwhile, in the last meeting at Banten International Stadium in August 2025, Persija was able to take home a 3-1 victory. 
 These records show that both teams have equal opportunities to achieve a positive result. 
 Persija and Dewa United Standings Ahead of the Match 
 Until the end of the seventh week, Persija Jakarta and Dewa United still occupy the top two positions in the 2026/2027 BRI Super League standings . 
 Position Club Played Points 
 1 Persija Jakarta 7 18 
 2 Dewa United 7 14 
 3 Bali United 7 13 
 4 Persib Bandung 7 13 
 5 Madura United 7 13 
 The standings show the importance of this match for both teams. 
 Persija has the opportunity to strengthen its position at the top while increasing pressure on its competitors. 
 Dewa United needs a win so as not to lose momentum in the top-tier competition. 
 Dewa United vs Persija Jakarta Score Prediction 
 Looking at recent performance, Persija has a slight advantage heading into the match. 
 Shin Tae-yong's team is on a positive trend, with quite good attacking productivity in the last two matches. 
 In addition to scoring seven goals in two matches, Persija also showed the ability to score from set-piece situations. 
 Denis Kolinger and Rizky Ridho are examples of how defenders can help the team when they are in a deadlock. 
 Conversely, Dewa United must immediately fix their defense after conceding four goals against Arema. 
 However, playing at Banten International Stadium could provide additional motivation for Osmar Loss's squad. 
 Persija is expected to try to control the game, while Dewa United has the opportunity to exploit space through the movements of their offensive players. 
 Score prediction Dewa United vs Persija Jakarta: 1-2 for a Persija victory. 
 This prediction is an analysis based on the latest performance and match results, not the official match result. 
 Schedule and Live Broadcast of Dewa United vs Persija 
 The match between Dewa United and Persija Jakarta can be watched via television broadcast and official streaming services. 
 Here is the match information:

 Kick-off 19:00 WIB / 20:00 WITA

 Broadcast schedules are subject to change according to the policies of the rights holder. 
 With the different conditions of both teams heading into the match, the Dewa United vs Persija Jakarta duel is expected to be interesting. 
 Persija needs a win to maintain distance from its competitors, while Dewa United wants to prove that the crushing defeat in Malang does not reflect their ability throughout the season. 
 The result of the Saturday night match will be one of the determinants of the direction of the top-tier competition in the 2026/2027 BRI Super League heading into the ninth week.
